acceptance: Archive reuse is rejected when the active Summary has changed any Outcome-derived input after its recorded aiSummary attestation, including knownGaps, changedFiles, verification evidence, or human-decision input.
A valid unchanged same-state archive retry still reuses verification without rerunning the full quality gate.
A stale warning Outcome is regenerated from the current Summary before any archive decision and becomes green when no warnings remain.
Blocked and warning Outcomes remain preserved when current evidence still requires them; no manual Outcome or report rewriting is used.
Focused lifecycle tests, full strict quality, generated capability evidence, and the normal archive/PR lifecycle pass.
guidelines: Bind archive reuse to all inputs that can alter the generated Outcome or human report.
Preserve fail-closed archive behavior and blocked Outcome recovery.
Use executable regressions for both stale and unchanged same-state paths.
Update lifecycle documentation and generated capability evidence for user-visible behavior.

intent.problem: A successful Work Item can retain an obsolete yellow Outcome after knownGaps are cleared because ai-finish reuses the prior same-state attestation without binding the Outcome input Summary. This blocks truthful green completion and archive, or risks archive using stale Outcome evidence.
constraints: Do not bypass quality, archive, Outcome, or status checks.
Do not hand-edit derived Outcome, report, status, or archive files to change lifecycle state.
Retain fast same-state archive retry only when both verification and all Outcome inputs are unchanged.
intent.rationale: A canonical input digest lets the lifecycle distinguish an unchanged retry from a stale Outcome, preserving both performance and evidence truth.

declaredIntent.summary: Complete the existing P1 #634 lifecycle truth correction, then resume the blocked governed Work Item plan without temporary workarounds.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add focused regression coverage for changed Outcome inputs and exercise the production archive-reuse predicate.
